Feathered Foes

Back to quest database

Craft and build a scarecrow, checking which variant the placement objective accepts.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Work through the objectives

  1. Prepare one ordinary Scarecrow or Bob the Scarecrow; the first condition also accepts one already built.
  2. Build one ordinary Scarecrow. This second condition names only the ordinary variant.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • If the Workbench is still locked, craft the ordinary Scarecrow, not Bob the Scarecrow; the ordinary current-build recipe does not require a workbench.
  • The two checks accept different variants. Bob satisfies the first condition but is not listed in the final build condition.
  • The task introduction describes scarecrows as crop protection against birds; no protection radius is specified here.

Sources and boundary

    Source: Steam thread: Scarecrow quest before Workbench unlock · Build: pre-EA-2026-03

  • The current-build recipe configuration independently corroborates that route: the ordinary Scarecrow does not require a workbench, while Bob the Scarecrow does. This does not establish the exact unlock timing. Game-build configuration
